dse_runs.notes: System spec: 32 requests issued at once per 1 us tick, all 32 must return within 0.44 us (p99). So need throughput >= 32 Msps AND batch latency <= 0.44 us for a batch of 32 -> per-request latency budget ~0.44us; pipelined/multi-lane families likely needed (32 lanes or high II=1 throughput with short latency). Accuracy: max_abs_err <= 2^-12 = 0.000244141, so accuracy_bits >= 12. Objective: minimise luts_plus_ffs (HV ref 4000), maximise accuracy_bits (HV ref 12). Selection rule: min luts_plus_ffs among feasible. L1 screens the system constraint with an analytic bound; keep the shortlist diverse in family (iterative, unrolled_k, pipelined, pipelined_m) so L2 can re-select on simulated p99.

final_text: The queue held a single spec, `multiaxis_control`, and it is now finalized. I spent the full 400-eval L1 budget in one `run_dse`, which returned a 24-design feasible, non-dominated front — entirely `pipelined_m` with m=4, i.e. 4 lanes at II=1 giving ~90 Msps against the 32 Msps requirement. L2 `simulate_system` on the top 8 showed the analytic batch bound was a mild underestimate (0.3848 → 0.3953 us for the leader, ~+0.011 us across the board), but every shortlisted design still passed the 0.44 us p99 constraint and the winner was unchanged, so the L1 selection survived the simulated re-selection. The L3/L4/L5 ladder (`verify_rtl`, `synthesize`, `back_annotate`) produced no recorded data for this design — `back_annotate` returned `no_measured_data` — so no winner change was flagged and `reexplore` was correctly skipped. The finalized selection is `pipelined_m:data_width=19,n_iter=15,angle_guard=2,frac_guard=2,rounding=trunc,m=4` with luts_plus_ffs=1340 (luts=1023, ffs=317), accuracy_bits=13.7, max_abs_err=7.77e-05 (2^-13.65), throughput_msps=93.6, and simulated sys_p99_batch_us=0.395 — feasible on all three constraints and the minimum-area point on the front, matching the spec's `min luts_plus_ffs` rule. Note that memory is switched off for this campaign, so the lesson I attempted to store (latency-bound system specs: full-budget `run_dse` plus `top_k=8` simulation; the analytic bound slightly under-predicts p99 but does not flip the min-area winner) was not persisted.
